QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off (the shipped default) | libc `calloc`, by macro | `include/mbedtls/platform.h:163-167`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that in the default build (PLATFORM_MEMORY off) mbedtls_calloc resolves to libc calloc by macro, which is a direct expansion with no indirection. It does not name free explicitly in the table, but the "calloc/free" pair is implied.
